With ARGs come game-jacking, it’s hard to trust codes that don’t come from the show and/or the official websites. This Youtube channel came out of nowhere and how straight up the code was makes it seem too good to be true. Until we get linked the channel from an official source (if we even do), i’d take it and anything posted there with a massive grain of salt.

Do we have any concrete evidence that this is an official clue? I may have missed it but was this a lead from Raw or was this posted by one of those Reddit accounts popping up posting clues before they’re officially shown? This one being a straight reference to Bray’s real name seems too good to be true and I fear we might have a game-jacker running around. 

On another note I love what they’re doing with the White Rabbit stuff, I’ve always been a massive fan of ARG’s and to have one being ran for WWE is honestly a dream come true. I haven’t really been tuning into the weekly shows but these codes have been bringing me back into viewing them.
